saving objects · 保存对象

The try-with-resources（TWR）语句

The try-with-resources (TWR) statement · 《Head First Java》p576

如果你用的是 Java 7 或更新的版本（我们当然希望你用的是！），那你就能用 try 语句的 try-with-resources 版本，让做 I/O 变得更容易。下面把我们之前一直在用的 try 代码，和做同样事情的 try-with-resources 代码对比一下：

private void saveFile(File file) {
  BufferedWriter writer = null;
  try {
    writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(file));

    for (QuizCard card : cardList) {
      writer.write(card.getQuestion() + "/");
      writer.write(card.getAnswer() + "\n");
    }

  } catch (IOException e) {
    System.out.println("Couldn't write the cardList out: " + e.getMessage());
  } finally {
    try {
      writer.close();
    } catch (Exception e) {
      System.out.println("Couldn't close writer: " + e.getMessage());
    }
  }
}

↑ 老写法：try-catch-finally 三部曲，还得自己手动 close。

private void saveFile(File file) {
  try (BufferedWriter writer =
         new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(file))) {

    for (QuizCard card : cardList) {
      writer.write(card.getQuestion() + "/");
      writer.write(card.getAnswer() + "\n");
    }

  } catch (IOException e) {
    System.out.println("Couldn't write the cardList out: " + e.getMessage());
  }
}

↑ 现代写法：把资源的声明放进 try 的圆括号里，close 的事交给编译器。

THERE ARE NO DUMB QUESTIONS · 没有愚蠢的问题
等等，什么？你之前明明告诉我们 try 语句必须配一个 catch 和／或一个 finally！

接得好！原来当你使用 try-with-resources 时，编译器会替你生成一个 finally 块。你看不到它，但它就在那里。
